TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Delhi Traffic Police has made special traffic arrangements in connection with the Shobha Yatra on the occasion of the 649th Jayanti of Shri Guru Ravi Dass Ji, to be held on 01.02.2026. 

The Shobha Yatra will commence from Red Fort Ground at 02:30 PM and conclude at Guru Ravidas Mandir, Guru Ravidas Marg around 08:00 PM.

Time: 02:30 PM – 08:00 PM

📍 PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Traffic will remain regulated on the Shobha Yatra route and adjoining roads
-Heavy footfall and vehicular movement expected on affected stretches
-Commuters are advised to avoid the routes, if possible and use alternate roads
-Prefer public transport to minimize congestion
-Follow instructions of traffic police personnel on duty
-Emergency vehicles will be facilitated uninterrupted movement

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police official channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

 Duration: 31-01-2026 | 7 Days |  Round the Clock

🔴 Madhapur / Kaithalapur → Kukatpally Y-Junction
➡️ Via IDL Lake Road
❌ Closed completely for 1 week
